title: 第15章 你师尊还能撑多久
novel_title: 修炼就修炼，你们别总想留宿啊
content_zh:
山风从悬崖下方灌上来，吹得陈元的灰袍猎猎作响。

    他手里的旧剑反射着冷光，剑尖稳稳指着玉玲珑的咽喉方向。

    “三个人，一个元婴初期两个金丹巅峰。加上陈元和唐玉，五个。”玉玲珑扫了一眼那三个血红色袍子的身影，声音压得很低，“我拖住陈元和元婴期那个，你找机会跑。”

    “师尊，我跑不了。”

    林尘靠在密道出口的石壁上。

    三颗火棘丹的药力还在经脉里烧着，但他的手指已经开始不受控制地微微发抖。

    “那两只蜘蛛的毒还在我体内，跑不出三里地就会被追上。”

    “那就别跑。”

    陈元替她回答了。

    他往前走了一步，旧剑在月光下泛着冷光。

    “把林尘交出来，你可以走。玉长老，你困在金丹后期六年，好不容易突破元婴，没必要为了一个弟子把命搭在这里。”

    玉玲珑没有回答。

    她拔剑出鞘，寒月诀的灵力在剑身上凝成一层淡蓝色的冰芒，周围的温度骤然降了几度。

    这就是她的回答。

    陈元看着她手里的剑，点了下头。

    他回头看了一眼身后三个血红色袍子的身影。

    “动手。”

    最先动的是那个元婴初期的血煞宗长老。

    他从阴影中走出来，是个五十来岁的中年男人，面容精瘦，颧骨很高，眼角有一道旧刀疤。

    他的双手从袖中伸出，手指枯瘦如柴，指甲却异常修长，泛着一层暗红色的光泽，像是常年浸泡在血里染出来的颜色。

    血煞宗外事长老，贺九。

    “玉玲珑。”

    贺九念了一遍她的名字，像在品一道还没上桌的菜。

    “早就听说苍梧宗有个女长老，三十岁出头就突破了元婴，一直想亲眼见见。没想到本人看着比传闻中还年轻。”

    他说这话的时候语气不紧不慢，那双眼睛从玉玲珑的脸一路往下扫，最后停在她握剑的手腕上。

    “元婴期的女修就是不一样，这皮肤保养得跟二十来岁的弟子似的。”

    玉玲珑没有接话。

    她一出手就是十成灵力——寒月诀毫无保留地在剑尖炸开，三道剑芒同时斩向贺九的面门、胸口和持剑的右手。

    这不是试探，是奔着三剑之内取他性命去的。

    贺九没有硬接。

    他的身形在原地晃了一下，整个人像一缕血雾般从剑芒的间隙中穿过，瞬间欺近玉玲珑身前三尺。

    五根泛着暗红光泽的指甲朝她面门抓下，指甲划过的空气发出滋滋的腐蚀声——这是血煞宗的血煞爪，以自身精血淬炼指甲，每一根指甲都淬了数十年积累的血毒，抓破皮肤就能渗入经脉，中者伤口溃烂不止。

    玉玲珑回剑格挡，剑身与指甲碰撞的瞬间炸开一串火星。

    贺九的五指被震开，指尖在剑身上刮出五道刺耳的摩擦声，暗红色的光泽在剑身上留下五道浅浅的划痕。

    他后退了一步，舔了舔嘴唇。

    “寒月诀果然名不虚传。不过你的剑越快，灵力消耗就越大。我不用跟你拼命，拖到你把灵力耗光就行。”

    他话音未落，身后两个金丹巅峰的血煞宗护法同时动了。

    两人的身形一个往左一个往右，像两道血影般绕过玉玲珑正面，朝她侧后方包抄过去。

    他们的步法飘忽如鬼影，每一步落地都在石板上留下一道淡淡的血痕——血影步，速度不如瞬身步快，但轨迹更加难以捉摸，跑动时身形会短暂地虚化成血雾，普通攻击难以锁定。

    其中一个绕到了玉玲珑身后，五指成爪朝她后颈抓下。

    玉玲珑侧身一剑逼退正面贺九的追击，同时左手反手一掌拍出。

    掌风击中偷袭者的胸口，将他震退三四步——金丹巅峰在元婴初期面前终究差了一个大境界，一击之下护体灵力险些被震散。

    但贺九趁她分神的瞬间欺近了身。

    五根指甲朝她腰侧抓去，玉玲珑回剑已经来不及，只能侧身避开要害，指甲擦着她的衣角划过，裙摆被撕开三道口子。

    贺九退后一步，把撕下的布料凑到鼻尖闻了一下。

    “寒月诀修炼出来的灵力果然特别。连衣料上都残留着一股凉意。”

    他将那片布料随手扔在脚下，嘴角扯开一个意味深长的笑。

    玉玲珑握剑的手指收紧了一分。

    林尘了解她的性格，师尊最恨的不是被打败，是被羞辱。

    贺九那几句污言秽语比他的血煞爪更让她愤怒，愤怒会让她出剑更快，但也会让她的灵力消耗更快。
content_en:
The mountain wind came up from the bottom of the cliff, making Chen Yuan's gray robe rustle.

    The old sword in his hand reflected cold light, and the tip of the sword was pointed steadily in the direction of Yu Linglong's throat.

    "Three people, one at the Nascent Soul stage and two at the peak of the Golden Core. Including Chen Yuan and Tang Yu, five." Yu Linglong glanced at the three figures in blood-red robes and spoke in a low voice, "I will hold back Chen Yuan and the Nascent Soul stage one, and you can find an opportunity to run away."

    "Master, I can't run away."

    Lin Chen leaned against the stone wall at the exit of the secret passage.

    The power of the three Firethorn Pills was still burning in his meridians, but his fingers had begun to tremble slightly uncontrollably.

    "The poison of those two spiders is still in my body. I won't be able to run more than three miles before I'm overtaken."

    "Then don't run."

    Chen Yuan answered for her.

    He took a step forward, the old sword glowing coldly in the moonlight.

    "Hand over Lin Chen and you can go. Elder Yu, you have been trapped in the late stage of Jindan for six years and finally broke through Nascent Soul. There is no need to risk your life here for a disciple."

    Yu Linglong didn't answer.

    She unsheathed her sword, and the spiritual power of Hanyue Jue condensed into a layer of light blue ice on the sword, and the surrounding temperature suddenly dropped a few degrees.

    This was her answer.

    Chen Yuan looked at the sword in her hand and nodded.

    He looked back at the three figures in blood-red robes behind him.

    "Do it."

    The first to move was the Blood Evil Sect elder who was in the early stage of Nascent Soul.

    He stepped out of the shadows. He was a middle-aged man in his fifties, with a lean face, high cheekbones, and an old scar at the corner of his eye.

    His hands stretched out from his sleeves. The fingers were as skinny as wood, but the nails were unusually long and glowed with a dark red sheen, as if they were dyed by being soaked in blood for many years.

    He Jiu, the foreign affairs elder of the Blood Evil Sect.

    "Jade Linglong."

    He Jiu read her name once, as if tasting a dish that hadn't been served yet.

    "I have long heard that there is a female elder in Cangwu Sect who broke through the Nascent Soul in her early thirties. I have always wanted to see it with my own eyes. I didn't expect that I look younger than the rumors."

    When he said this, his tone was leisurely, and his eyes swept down from Yu Linglong's face, and finally stopped on her wrist holding the sword.

    "Female cultivators in the Nascent Soul stage are different. Their skin is maintained like that of a disciple in their twenties."

    Yu Linglong didn't answer.

    She used 100% of her spiritual power as soon as she took action - Han Yue Jue exploded at the tip of the sword without any reservation, and three sword rays slashed at He Jiu's face, chest and right hand holding the sword at the same time.

    This is not a temptation, it is an attempt to take his life within three swords.

    He Jiu did not force the answer.

    His figure swayed on the spot, and his whole figure passed through the gap between the swords like a wisp of blood mist, instantly approaching three feet in front of Yu Linglong.

    Five nails with a dark red luster clawed at her face, and the air they scratched made a sizzling corrosive sound - these were the blood evil claws of the Blood Evil Sect. They tempered the nails with their own essence and blood. Each nail was tempered with decades of accumulated blood poison. If it scratched the skin, it would seep into the meridians, and the wound would fester.

    Yu Linglong returned her sword to block, and a string of sparks exploded the moment the sword collided with her nails.

    He Jiu's five fingers were shaken open, and his fingertips made five harsh friction sounds on the sword. The dark red luster left five shallow scratches on the sword.

    He took a step back and licked his lips.

    "Han Yue Jue is indeed well-deserved. However, the faster your sword is, the greater the consumption of spiritual power. I don't have to fight with you, I just need to drag you until you use up all your spiritual power."

    Before he finished speaking, the two Blood Evil Sect guardians behind him who were at the peak of Golden Core moved at the same time.

    The two figures moved one to the left and the other to the right, like two blood shadows, bypassing Yu Linglong's front and outflanking her side and behind.

    Their footwork is as erratic as ghost shadows, and each step leaves a faint trace of blood on the stone slab - the blood shadow step. The speed is not as fast as the instant step, but the trajectory is more elusive. When running, the body will briefly turn into a blood mist, making it difficult to target with normal attacks.

    One of them came around behind Yu Linglong and clawed at the back of her neck.

    Yu Linglong turned her sword sideways to repel He Jiu's pursuit from the front, and at the same time struck out with a backhand palm with her left hand.

    The palm wind hit the sneaker's chest, knocking him back three or four steps - the peak of the golden elixir was finally a big step away from the early stage of Nascent Soul, and the body-protecting spiritual power was almost shaken away by one blow.

    But He Jiu took advantage of her distracted moment and came closer.

    Five nails clawed at her waist. It was too late for Yu Linglong to return her sword, so she could only turn sideways to avoid the vital points. The nails scraped against the corner of her clothes, and the hem of her skirt was torn open three times.

    He Jiu took a step back, brought the torn cloth to his nose and smelled it.

    "The spiritual power cultivated through Hanyue Jue is indeed special. There is even a chill left on the material of the clothes."

    He threw the piece of fabric at his feet and gave a meaningful smile.

    Yu Linglong's fingers holding the sword tightened a little.

    Lin Chen understood her character. What Master hated most was not being defeated, but being humiliated.

    He Jiu's dirty words made her angrier than his bloody claws. Anger would make her draw the sword faster, but it would also consume her spiritual power faster.
title_en: Chapter 15 How long can your master last?
